_comment: Proposed 8-axis motor set of docs/design/MOTOR_SELECTION.ko.md (hip pitch RS03 direct, hip roll RS06 + 1.5:1 belt, knee RS03 + four-bar, tail pitch RS03, tail yaw RS06) for RunEnv(arch8=True, realism='sim/rl/realism_robstride.json'). Merged onto realism_default.json. Electrical/mechanical values come from docs/design/motor_candidates.json (RobStride official manuals, verified there); every thermal value is an ESTIMATE from a similar literature motor (no vendor publishes them). Not validated against hardware.

motor.spec_file_note: the 'modules' entries are converted by realism.survey_module_spec: kt = kt_out/ratio, gear_efficiency 1 (kt_out is measured at the output, internal gear loss included), j_rotor = j_out/ratio^2, i_peak = tau_peak/kt_out (DC-equivalent current reproducing the published peak torque), r_phase = r_line (line-to-line). Back-EMF uses the same kt: no-load speed V/kt_out is 20.3 rad/s for RS03 (datasheet 20.4) and 44.0 rad/s for RS06 (datasheet 50.3, i.e. 12 % conservative).
motor.assign_note: link_efficiency 0.9 = LINK_ETA of run_env/motor_selection_calc for a belt or linkage stage; ankle_pitch is coupled to the knee in arch8 (no motor), ankle_roll is locked in arch8: null keeps the env's own limits

r_th_wh.source: maxon EC 90 flat 260 W (980 g, similar size to RS03 880-928 g): thermal resistance winding-housing 1.82 K/W, catalogue page edition 2021-03 (web search summary 2026-10-28, maxongroup.com PDF not opened: host blocked in this session)

r_th_ha.source: same maxon EC 90 flat 260 W page: housing-ambient 1.74 K/W (free air, no heat sink)

c_th_w.source: derived: winding time constant 57 s / 1.82 K/W (same maxon page)

c_th_h.source: derived: motor time constant 258 s / 1.74 K/W (same maxon page)

r_th_wh.source: maxon EC 90 flat 90 W, datasheet edition 2009-05 (web search summary 2026-10-28, not opened): winding-housing 2.99 K/W; smaller RS06 (615-621 g)

r_th_ha.source: same maxon EC 90 flat 90 W: housing-ambient 1.89 K/W (2013 edition 1.91 K/W)

c_th_w.source: derived: winding time constant 52.6 s / 2.99 K/W (same maxon EC 90 flat 90 W datasheet)

c_th_h.source: derived: motor time constant 281 s / 1.89 K/W (same maxon EC 90 flat 90 W datasheet)

motor.spec_override_note: consistency check (docs/SIM_REALISM.ko.md): with these free-air values the RobStride rated torque (20 / 11 N·m, measured on a 215x220 / 130x160 mm heat sink) would not settle below the 145 C protection limit at 25 C ambient, so this set is pessimistic for a heat-sunk mount; scaling r_th_wh and r_th_ha by 0.545 (RS03) reproduces the rating

thermal.loss_factor_note: ESTIMATE: kt_out is per A rms of phase current and r_line is line-to-line; for a star winding the copper loss 3 I^2 R_phase = 1.5 I^2 r_line
